les: Instrumente op sig en op gehoor
kaps_punt: Onderwerp 4 - Waardeer en nadenke, Kwartaal 1. Geselekteerde voorbeelde van Westerse- of Afrikamusiek, klassifisering van die instrument visueel en op gehoor (luister en kyk na prente), neem toonkleur en uitdrukking van verskillende stemminge in ag. Eie en ander se optredes en prosesse deur die gebruik van eenvoudige skeppende kunsterminologie.

items.bewering: 'n Westerse orkes se instrumente word in vier families verdeel.
items.bron: Queensland Symphony Orchestra, 'About the orchestra' (qso.com.au/education/resources/about-the-orchestra); Lumen Learning music appreciation chapter: strings, woodwinds, brass, percussion. Some sources list keyboards separately as not always present, which does not touch the claim.

items.bewering: Uit Graad 4 weet jy dat instrumente in families gegroepeer word volgens hoe hulle klank maak.
items.bron: KABV Lewensvaardighede Gr 4-6, Gr 4 Uitvoerende Kunste Onderwerp 4, Kwartaal 1-3 (gedrukte bl. 35-37): 'Klassifiseer verskeie instrumente as deel van 'n familie of groep in terme van ... hoe die klank voortgebring word'. Grouping of the orchestral families by sound production, not material: woodwind classification sources (Wikipedia 'Woodwind instrument'; uv.es CLIL flute page).

items.bewering: By snaarinstrumente soos die viool en die tjello vibreer 'n snaar as die speler dit tokkel of stryk.
items.bron: Lumen Learning orchestra chapter (strings bowed or plucked); Stanford CCRMA 'Strings' course page (bowed string stick-slip motion).

items.bewering: Slaginstrumente word geslaan, geskud of geskraap, soos die trom en die xilofoon.
items.bron: Lumen Learning orchestra chapter: 'Percussion instruments create sound when they are hit, shaken, or scraped', naming the xylophone among them.

items.bewering: By houtblaasinstrumente soos die fluit blaas die speler oor 'n skerp rand. By ander houtblaas soos die klarinet laat die lug 'n dun riet vibreer.
items.bron: Lumen Learning orchestra chapter (flute blown across the hole; clarinet single reed that vibrates); Northern Illinois University clarinet acoustics page (niu.edu/gbarrett/resources/acoustics.shtml).

items.bewering: By koperblaasinstrumente soos die trompet en die tromboon gons die speler se lippe in 'n mondstuk.
items.bron: Lumen Learning orchestra chapter: 'Musicians make sound by buzzing their lips into their mouthpieces'; Classics for Kids, 'Brass instruments'.

items.bewering: Kyk eers na die mondstuk: die meeste houtblaasinstrumente het 'n riet of 'n blaasgat.
items.bron: Lumen Learning orchestra chapter: flute blown across a hole; clarinet single reed; oboe, cor anglais, bassoon double reed. The recorder is the exception and the lesson names it in the next sentence. 'Die meeste' holds.

items.bewering: Die blokfluit het geen riet of blaasgat nie, maar 'n skerp rand by 'n klein venstertjie net onder die mondstuk.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Fipple'; New World Encyclopedia 'Recorder (music)': breath travels along the windway to a sharp edge, the labium; the opening beside it is called the window; no reed.

items.bewering: By koperblaas lyk die mondstuk van metaal soos 'n klein beker of tregter.
items.bron: Lumen Learning orchestra chapter: 'metal, cup-shaped mouthpieces'; R. Pyle, Second Vienna Talk 2010 (viennatalk.mdw.ac.at): deep funnel-shaped (horn) against bowl-shaped (trumpet) mouthpieces. The shape comparison holds and leads a learner nowhere false.

items.bewering: Houtblaas het dikwels baie kleppe, en koperblaas het 'n paar ventiele of 'n lang skuif.
items.bron: hellomusictheory.com 'Parts of the clarinet' and muzines.co.uk (padded keys cover the tone holes); Lumen Learning orchestra chapter (brass pitch changed with valves or slides); NTBIS 'How valves are used to change the note played' (three valves on a trumpet). 'Dikwels' correctly leaves room for the recorder.

items.bewering: By snaarinstrumente sien jy die snare en by baie slaginstrumente die vel of die latte wat geslaan word.
items.bron: Hartenberger World Musical Instrument Collection, Venda ngoma (ox-hide head) (wmic.net/venda-ngoma-drum); UNESCO ICH 'Chopi timbila' (wooden slats). 'Baie' rightly avoids claiming every percussion instrument.

items.bewering: Die naam houtblaas kom van die hout waarvan die meeste houtblaasinstrumente gemaak word of vroeër gemaak is.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Woodwind instrument'; zientzia.eus 'Route of the wooden flute to metal' (earlier flutes were wooden and the name survived the move to metal).

items.bewering: Die naam koperblaas kom van koper.
items.bron: Interglot (Dutch 'koperblazers' for the class of brass instruments); Getty AAT 300010946 and webwoordenboek.nl (Dutch 'koper' for the metal, 'geelkoper' for brass the alloy). The Afrikaans compound takes its name from the metal word 'koper', and the next sentence correctly says the instruments are mostly brass, not copper.

items.bewering: Die meeste koperblaasinstrumente is van geelkoper, 'n metaal wat grotendeels koper is.
items.bron: Yamaha musical instrument guide, 'How a Trumpet is Made' (yamaha.com): brass is 'an alloy consisting of 70% copper and 30% zinc'; yellow brass is the standard material for trumpets and most brass instruments. Getty AAT: copper is the main component, zinc up to about 40%.

items.bewering: Tog bepaal die materiaal nie die familie nie. Die fluit is meestal van metaal en tog houtblaas.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Woodwind instrument'; uv.es CLIL 'Flute family': modern concert flutes are metal and are woodwinds because of how they make sound, not what they are made of.

items.bewering: Jy kan 'n instrument ook aan sy toonkleur uitken sonder om te kyk.
items.bron: Siedenburg & McAdams, 'Four Distinctions for the Auditory Wastebasket of Timbre', Frontiers in Psychology 2017 (PMC5632649): timbre is used to identify sound sources, for example to tell a violin from a flute.

items.bewering: 'n Fluit en 'n trompet kan ewe hoog en hard speel en tog heel anders klink.
items.bron: Ranges: concert flute C4-C7 (uv.es CLIL 'Flute family'), trumpet about F#3-C6 written (uv.es CLIL 'Trumpet'; andrewhugill.com), so the ranges overlap across about two octaves. ANSI definition of timbre (quoted in PMC5632649): two sounds with the same pitch and loudness can still be judged dissimilar.

items.bewering: So kan jy dikwels ook die instrument se familie hoor, maar nie altyd nie.
items.bron: Follows from the family cues confirmed in the list below, all of which are hedged. Beatkitchen orchestral guide: brass can play as softly as woodwind, so loudness alone does not always reveal the family.

items.bewering: Snaarinstrumente: 'n gestrykte noot kan lank aanhou, maar 'n getokkelde noot sterf weg.
items.bron: D. Russell, Penn State Acoustics and Vibration Animations, 'Bowed string' (plucked string vibration is a decaying transient; bowed string is a self-sustained oscillator); University of Washington violin physics chapter (digital.lib.washington.edu).

items.bewering: Houtblaasinstrumente: hulle klink dikwels sagter as koperblaas.
items.bron: Beatkitchen 'Writing for brass' (brass is the loudest section); a Wisconsin orchestra lesson (woodwinds more delicate-sounding); Vienna Symphonic Library forum (brass reaches higher maximum levels than woodwind). 'Dikwels' is right, because brass can also play softly.

items.bewering: Koperblaasinstrumente: hulle kan baie hard klink.
items.bron: Beatkitchen 'Writing for brass'; Time for Kids 'In the orchestra' (the brass section is very loud).

items.bewering: Slaginstrumente: by baie begin die klank skielik en sterf dan weg.
items.bron: D. Russell, Penn State Acoustics: a struck excitation is an initial-condition problem whose vibration is a decaying transient. 'By baie' rightly leaves out rolls and rattles.

items.bewering: Die ngoma, die timbila en die hosho ken jy uit Graad 4.
items.bron: Wolkskool Gr 4 Uitvoerende Kunste lessons in this repository: lesson 1 and 2 word lists carry ngoma and hosho, and lesson 3 carries timbila. KABV Gr 4 itself names no instrument, so the cross-reference holds for a Wolkskool learner and not by CAPS alone.

items.bewering: Die eerste twee word geslaan en die hosho geskud. Al drie is dus slaginstrumente.
items.bron: wmic.net Venda ngoma and thungwa (ox-hide head struck); UNESCO ICH 'Chopi timbila' (wooden xylophones); Wikipedia 'Hosho (instrument)' and Grinnell College musical instrument collection (rattles shaken one in each hand).

items.bewering: Of 'n instrument 'n melodie kan speel, is 'n ander vraag as tot watter familie dit behoort. Daarvoor moet dit note van verskillende toonhoogtes maak.
items.bron: Lumen Learning orchestra chapter: some percussion is pitched (xylophone, timpani), some unpitched (cymbals, bass drum), so the family does not settle it; Britannica summary 'melody' (a succession of single tones).

items.bewering: Elke houtlat van die timbila klink op 'n ander toonhoogte. Die timbila is dus slaginstrumente en ook melodiese instrumente.
items.bron: ILAM, Rhodes University digital archives (Hugh Tracey's Chopi timbila recordings, 1949-1963), which list each orchestra's tuning as distinct pitches per key; UNESCO ICH 'Chopi timbila' ('finely manufactured and tuned wooden instruments').

items.bewering: Die hosho het geen vaste toonhoogte nie en speel nie 'n melodie nie.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Rattle (percussion instrument)' and Britannica 'Percussion instrument' (rattles are of indefinite pitch); Grinnell College collection (seed rattle: pitch indefinite).

items.bewering: Musiek kan 'n rustige, vrolike, hartseer of opgewonde stemming uitdruk.
items.bron: Juslin & Lindström (2010), as summarised in Frontiers in Psychology 2013 (10.3389/fpsyg.2013.00487); a review on arousal (happiness and excitement high arousal; sadness and calmness low).

items.bewering: Tempo en volume werk saam met toonhoogte en toonkleur om die stemming te skep.
items.bron: Juslin & Laukka meta-analyses of expressive cues (tempo, sound level, pitch, timbre and others), as summarised in Frontiers in Psychology 2013 and the Corrigall & Schellenberg 2013 paper (utoronto.ca).

items.bewering: Stadige en sagte musiek klink dikwels rustig. Vinnige en harde musiek klink dikwels vrolik. Tog is dit nie 'n reël nie.
items.bron: Juslin & Laukka (secondary summary): happiness goes with fast tempo and high sound level; slow tempo and soft timbre go with low-arousal emotions such as calmness. Juslin 1997 and Juslin & Laukka 2003: the cues are 'probabilistic rather than deterministic', which matches 'dikwels' and 'nie 'n reël nie'. Fast and loud is also linked to anger and excitement, which the hedge covers.

items.bewering: Hierdie kwartaal voer julle ritmes en musiekfrases uit.
items.bron: KABV Lewensvaardighede Gr 5 Uitvoerende Kunste Kwartaal 1 (gedrukte bl. 39), Onderwerp 2 (rhythmic patterns) and Onderwerp 3 ('Musiekfrases met stem en/of instrumente').

items.bewering: familie: 'n Groep instrumente wat saamgegroepeer word volgens die manier waarop hulle klank maak.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Woodwind instrument' and uv.es CLIL (family is by sound production, not material); Lumen Learning orchestra chapter. The 'family' image is defined at once, so a learner is not led to think the instruments are related by descent.

items.bewering: snaarinstrument: 'n Instrument wat klank maak as 'n gespanne snaar vibreer.
items.bron: Stanford CCRMA 'Strings'; Penn State Acoustics 'Bowed string'.

items.bewering: houtblaasinstrument: 'n Blaasinstrument wat klank maak met 'n skerp rand of 'n riet.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Woodwind instrument'; Lumen Learning orchestra chapter.

items.bewering: koperblaasinstrument: 'n Blaasinstrument waarby die speler se lippe in 'n mondstuk gons.
items.bron: Lumen Learning orchestra chapter; Classics for Kids 'Brass instruments'.

items.bewering: slaginstrument: 'n Instrument wat klank maak as jy dit slaan, skud of skraap.
items.bron: Lumen Learning orchestra chapter (hit, shaken, or scraped).

items.bewering: xilofoon: 'n Instrument met houtlatte wat jy met stokkies slaan.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Xylophone' (wooden bars struck with mallets); Museum of Fine Arts Boston, mbila with mallet.

items.bewering: mondstuk: Die deel van 'n blaasinstrument waarin of waarteen die speler blaas.
items.bron: Edinburgh University musical instrument collection (mimed) mouthpiece records; Wikipedia 'Fipple' (recorder mouthpiece and windway).

items.bewering: riet: 'n Dun plaatjie by die mondstuk wat vibreer as die speler blaas.
items.bron: Northern Illinois University clarinet acoustics (the reed vibrates and closes the opening on every cycle at loud levels); muzines.co.uk.

items.bewering: klep: 'n Dekseltjie wat 'n gat in die instrument se lyf oop- of toemaak.
items.bron: muzines.co.uk and hellomusictheory.com 'Parts of the clarinet': padded keys cover and uncover the tone holes.

items.bewering: ventiel: 'n Knoppie wat die lug deur 'n langer stuk pyp stuur.
items.bron: NTBIS 'How valves are used to change the note played' (ntbis.org.uk): pressing a valve diverts the air through a loop of extra tubing. A horn's rotary valve is worked by a lever rather than a button, which is within a Grade 5 simplification.

items.bewering: vibreer: Om baie vinnig heen en weer te beweeg.
items.bron: Stanford CCRMA 'Strings' (the string is carried with the bow and moves rapidly back, cycle after cycle); Penn State Acoustics.

items.bewering: toonkleur: Waaraan jy 'n instrument uitken, al klink dit ewe hoog en hard.
items.bron: ANSI acoustical terminology definition of timbre and its source-identification use, both in Siedenburg & McAdams, Frontiers in Psychology 2017 (PMC5632649).

items.bewering: melodie: 'n Wysie van note met verskillende toonhoogtes wat ná mekaar klink.
items.bron: Britannica summary 'melody': a rhythmic succession of single tones; Merriam-Webster 'melody'.

items.bewering: melodiese instrument: 'n Instrument wat note van verskillende toonhoogtes maak en so 'n melodie kan speel.
items.bron: Lumen Learning orchestra chapter (pitched percussion such as the xylophone plays pitched notes); Britannica summary 'melody'.

items.bewering: stemming: Die gevoel wat 'n stuk musiek, 'n dans, 'n drama of 'n prent uitdruk of skep.
items.bron: KABV Gr 4-5 Uitvoerende Kunste uses 'stemming' for music, movement and tablo (gedrukte bl. 37-39); Juslin & Lindström 2010 on music both expressing and evoking emotion (Frontiers in Psychology 2013 summary).

items.bewering: tempo: Hoe vinnig of stadig die polsslag van die musiek gaan.
items.bron: Britannica Dictionary 'tempo' (the speed at which a piece is played); tempo given as beats per minute, i.e. the speed of the beat.

items.bewering: toonhoogte: Hoe hoog of hoe laag 'n klank is.
items.bron: KABV Gr 4 'toonhoogte klassifikasie (hoog-laag)' (gedrukte bl. 35); ANSI terminology as quoted in PMC5632649 (pitch as a separate attribute from loudness).

items.bewering: volume: Hoe hard of hoe sag 'n klank is.
items.bron: ANSI terminology as quoted in PMC5632649 (loudness as an attribute separate from pitch and timbre).

items.bewering: ngoma: Die grootste en diepste trom wat die VhaVenda gebruik, met beesvel oor uitgeholde hout.
items.bron: Cambridge anthropology ERA resource 'Venda Girls - Milayo: Ngomani, by the drums' (era.anthropology.ac.uk): the ngoma khulwane is the 'big bass drum' and the mirumba the smallest alto drums; Hartenberger World Musical Instrument Collection (wmic.net/venda-ngoma-drum): the large Venda drum, 'carved out of solid wood', mouth 'covered by an ox-hide'. Largest and lowest are both supported.

items.bewering: hosho: 'n Kalbasratel van Zimbabwe met sade binne, in pare geskud.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Hosho (instrument)' (pair of maranka gourds with hota seeds; Shona music of Zimbabwe); Grinnell College musical instrument collection ('usually played in pairs, one rattle in each hand'). A few players use one rattle, which does not make a glossary line false.

items.bewering: timbila: Die Chopi se xilofone, met 'n hol dop onder elke houtlat.
items.bron: UNESCO ICH 'Chopi timbila' (ich.unesco.org/en/RL/chopi-timbila-00133): wooden xylophones called timbila, with a calabash resonator fastened under each wooden slat; Penn Museum object 157782 (mbila, plural timbila; resonators of wild citrus shells). 'Hol dop' covers both materials.

items.bewering: ritme: Die patroon van lang en kort klanke en stiltes in musiek.
items.bron: bigcomposer.com rhythm lecture and guitaralliance.net (rhythm as the pattern of the lengths of sounds and silences); KABV Gr 5 note values with their equivalent rests (gedrukte bl. 39).

items.bewering: roep-en-antwoord: Een persoon of groep sing of speel 'n kort deel en 'n ander antwoord daarop.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Call and response (music)'; NCpedia glossary 'call-and-response'.

items.bewering: in kanon: Wanneer almal dieselfde sing, klap of beweeg, maar nie saam begin nie.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Round (music)': voices sing exactly the same melody, each beginning at a different time; EPFL Graph Search 'Canon'.

items.bewering: heelnoot: 'n Noot wat so lank duur soos twee halwenote.
items.bron: piano-keyboard-guide.com and vaia.com 'Note values' (whole 4 beats, half 2 beats in 4/4).

items.bewering: halwenoot: 'n Noot wat so lank duur soos twee kwartnote.
items.bron: vaia.com 'Note values'; piano-keyboard-guide.com.

items.bewering: kwartnoot: 'n Noot wat half so lank duur as 'n halwenoot.
items.bron: vaia.com 'Note values'.

items.bewering: agtstenoot: 'n Noot wat half so lank duur as 'n kwartnoot.
items.bron: vaia.com 'Note values' and piano-keyboard-guide.com (two eighth notes form a quarter note).

items.bewering: rustekens: Tekens wat wys hoe lank 'n speler of sanger stilbly.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Rest (music)'; vaia.com 'Rests' (a rest indicates silence for a certain length of time).

items.bewering: asemhaling: Om lug in te asem en weer uit te asem.
items.bron: KABV Gr 5 Kwartaal 1 Onderwerp 1 (gedrukte bl. 39): 'oefeninge vir bewustheid van asemhaling' in voice warm-ups; the plain meaning of the word.

items.bewering: fokus: By oefeninge en speletjies: om jou aandag by een ding te hou.
items.bron: KABV Gr 5 Kwartaal 1 Onderwerp 1 (gedrukte bl. 39): 'Konsentrasie en fokusspeletjies'; a definition in the sense CAPS uses.

items.bewering: sintuie: Die maniere waarop jy agterkom wat om jou is, soos sien, hoor, proe, aanraak en ruik.
items.bron: KABV Gr 5 Kwartaal 1 Onderwerp 2 (gedrukte bl. 39): 'die vyf sintuie (sien, hoor, proe, aanraak, ruik)'.

items.bewering: tyd: In beweging: hoe vinnig of hoe stadig jy beweeg.
items.bron: KABV Gr 5 Kwartaal 1 Onderwerp 3 (gedrukte bl. 39): 'kontras in tyd (vinnig/stadig)'; Ballet Hispanico 'Elements of Dance' (time: tempo, speed).

items.bewering: vlak: In beweging: die hoogte waarop jy beweeg, soos hoog, medium of laag.
items.bron: KABV Gr 5 Kwartaal 1 Onderwerp 3 (gedrukte bl. 39): 'vlakke (hoog/medium/laag)'; Ballet Hispanico 'Elements of Dance'.

items.bewering: rigting: In beweging: waarheen jy beweeg, soos vorentoe, agtertoe, na die kant, op, af of skuins.
items.bron: KABV Gr 5 Kwartaal 1 Onderwerp 3 (gedrukte bl. 39): 'rigting (vorentoe/agtertoe/na die kant/op/af/diagonaal)'; 'skuins' renders 'diagonaal'.

items.bewering: krag: In beweging: hoe sterk of lig en hoe vloeiend of rukkerig jy beweeg.
items.bron: KABV Gr 5 Kwartaal 1 Onderwerp 3 (gedrukte bl. 39): 'krag (vloeiend/rukkerig, sterk/lig)'; Ballet Hispanico 'Elements of Dance' (energy: strong, light, free-flow, sharp).

opsomming: Every claim in the lesson checked out, including the four 'meeste'/'grootste' superlatives and the mouthpiece comparison, so nothing needs fixing: the ngoma as the largest, lowest Venda drum rests on a Cambridge ethnography resource and one museum collection, and 'ken jy uit Graad 4' holds only for learners who did Wolkskool's own Grade 4 lessons, because CAPS Grade 4 names no instruments.
